EMAIL_TITLE: A change to SoulPrint Engine — starting October 1
SUBJECT: A change to SoulPrint Engine — starting October 1
HEADLINE: We're simplifying SoulPrint Engine on October 1.
PARAGRAPHS: You were one of the first people to sign up for SoulPrint Engine, so you're owed a straight answer about where it's going — and plenty of notice before anything changes.

Here's the short version: we're going all-in on the thing we're actually different at — an AI that knows you, remembers you, and follows you from one assistant to the next. Everything that doesn't serve that is moving out.

FEATURES.title: Image and video generation
FEATURES.desc: Moving to The Foundry, where creating is the whole point.

FEATURES.title: Voice calls
FEATURES.desc: Retired for good. Chat is for writing.

FEATURES.title: Uploading files and PDFs into chat
FEATURES.desc: Retired. Chat is for talking, not for reading documents at you.

FEATURES.title: Credit packs and add-on plans
FEATURES.desc: Gone. One plan, no tiers, no upsells.

FEATURES.title: Old banners and half-used settings
FEATURES.desc: Cleaned up, so the page is quiet again.

QUOTE_TEXT: Most of this was never the point. Chat should be a clean, personal place to talk to an AI that already knows you.
PANEL_CONTENT: Chat itself, exactly as it works today. Your memories — everything you've saved stays, and stays yours. Your conversation history, intact. Read-out-loud. Settings, kept but simplified. Export and delete, always available and always free.
CALLOUT_TEXT: Your account and your data stay exactly as they are. If you'd like a copy of everything, you can export it any time.
SIGNOFF_TEXT: If you've been using SoulPrint Engine for something specific that this affects, just reply to this email. It comes straight to us, and we'll help you find the right home for it. Thanks for being here early.
